decision.reason: Both evidence excerpts [ev-782bc47d120d] and [ev-c2c6c790d6b2] show only "apiVersion: v1" from the v2.6.4 and v2.7.0 install.yaml. They do not show which CRD, API version or field path the removed line 'Deprecated: Replaced by the composite "observedPreviousRef" field.' belonged to. They also do not say whether the deprecated field itself was removed or only its description was changed. To write the subject, change, applicability and consequence, we need the surrounding CRD schema context from both manifests (or matching release notes or a linked PR).
